examples.text: The <w>stalwart</w> athlete easily lifted the heavy weights above his head.

examples.text: She is a <w>stalwart</w> woman who works hard on the farm every day.

target_lang_definitions.it: Fisicamente robusto, solido o di costituzione forte.

riferito a una corporatura imponente e solida

examples.text: The <w>stalwart</w> soldiers defended their country against all odds.

target_lang_definitions.it: Persona che sostiene con fermezza e lealtà una causa, un partito o un'organizzazione.

senses.sense_definition: A person who is dependable and reliable

examples.text: Political history books often describe the conflict between the <w>Stalwarts</w> and their rivals.
